objective.text: The objective of this ground investigation was to use flight data obtained from PSI through NASA’s Flame Extinguishment Experiment to quantify how externally imposed thermal and convective perturbations regulated the dynamics and ultimate fate of already established droplet cool flames.
objective.quote: The objective of this ground investigation was to use flight data obtained from PSI through NASA’s Flame Extinguishment Experiment (FLEX) to quantify how externally imposed thermal and convective perturbations regulated the dynamics and ultimate fate of already established droplet cool flames

fuel.text: OpenFOAM was used to develop a 3-D CFD model of n-alkane droplet cool flames in microgravity.
fuel.quote: OpenFOAM was used to develop a 3-D CFD model of n-alkane droplet cool flames in microgravity

sample_geometry.text: Controlled simulations examined three forcing modes applied to both large and sub-millimeter droplets.
sample_geometry.quote: controlled simulations examined three forcing modes (i) convection alone to mimic droplet drift, (ii) imposed heat flux, and (iii) combined convection plus heating applied to both large (1–4 mm) and sub-millimeter (~0.5 mm) droplets

variables.text: Parameter sweeps were performed over forcing amplitude and frequency, ambient composition, and pressure.
variables.quote: parameter sweeps over forcing amplitude and frequency, ambient composition (including ozone-assisted cases), and pressure

measurements.text: Predictive observables were extracted including ignition delay, oscillation frequency and amplitude, and stand-off and extinction diameters.
measurements.quote: From each case, predictive observables were extracted (ignition delay, oscillation frequency and amplitude, stand-off and extinction diameters)

source.ref: Objectives, Approach, Hypothesis, Research Impacts/Earth Benefits

earth_benefits.text: This research advances low-temperature combustion understanding relevant to engine knock, efficiency, and emissions, and delivers validated CFD tools transferrable to practical combustors.
earth_benefits.quote: Advances low-temperature combustion understanding relevant to engine knock, efficiency, and emissions; delivers validated CFD tools transferrable to practical combustors
